rules.name: rrr-base-parity-cfs
rules.sql: SELECT created_by, CAST(created_timestamp AS date) AS created_day, updated_by, CAST(updated_timestamp AS date) AS updated_day, COUNT(*) AS n_rows FROM opera.helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table WHERE tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1) AND business_unit = :bu AND value_date = :valueDate GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4 ORDER BY n_rows DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT created_by, CAST(created_timestamp AS date) AS created_day, updated_by, CAST(updated_timestamp AS date) AS updated_day, COUNT(*) AS n_rows FROM opera.security_settlement_value_table WHERE tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1) AND business_unit = :bu AND value_date = :valueDate GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4 ORDER BY n_rows DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT security_id, settle_price, settle_delta_1, settle_vega_1, settle_theta FROM dbsystemuat.security_settlement_value_table_cfs WHERE value_date = :valueDate

SELECT security_id, settle_price, settle_delta_1, settle_vega_1, settle_theta FROM opera.security_settlement_value_table WHERE tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1) AND business_unit = :bu AND value_date = :valueDate
SELECT underlying_id, settle_value, risk_free_rate, div_yield FROM dbsystemuat.underlying_settle_value_table WHERE value_date = :valueDate

SELECT underlying_id, settle_value, risk_free_rate, div_yield FROM opera.underlying_settle_value_table WHERE tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1) AND value_date = :valueDate
